source_metadata.scope: native invocation including runtime packing, dispatch and output allocation; repeated runtime inputs, no cache flush

variants.01_original: unmodified IREE data-tiling, complete A/B packing, target-selected ukernel (8x8x1 for tested AVX2 targets)
variants.02_panel_pack: NC/KC/MC panel packing interleaved with compute, original 8x8x1 ukernel; MC=64 NC=128 KC=256
variants.03_panel_pack_kernel: same panel schedule with row-major 6x16 output kernel, K unrolled by 8; MC=60 NC=128 KC=256
variants.04_full_pack_kernel: complete A/B packing in separate encoding dispatches; 6x16 output kernel, full K reduction; original distribution granularity of one M tile and two N tiles per workgroup
